source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 13: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Denominator mein ek linear factor \(x - 1\) aur ek quadratic factor \(x^2 + 1\) jo do dafa (square) aa raha hai. Repeated irreducible quadratic, yani Case-IV.
Upar degree 4, neeche degree 5 (\(2 \times 2 + 1\)), is liye fraction proper hai.
Paanch constants chahiye: \(A\) linear factor ke liye, \(Bx + C\) aur \(Dx + E\) quadratic ki dono powers ke liye.
Plan: \(x = 1\) se \(A\), baaqi coefficients compare kar ke; aakhri tukra \(\int \frac{dx}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\) Example 43 ki tarah \(x = \tan\theta\) se.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x^4 + 3x^2 + x + 1}{(x^2 + 1)^2(x - 1)}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: partial fractions, Case-IV. Yeh is exercise ka sab se lamba sawal hai, is liye har qadam saaf likhenge aur beech mein tasdeeq bhi karenge.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 1} + \dfrac{Dx + E}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\]
\[x^4 + 3x^2 + x + 1 = A(x^2 + 1)^2\]
\[+\, (Bx + C)(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)\]
\[+\, (Dx + E)(x - 1) \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Repeated quadratic \((x^2 + 1)^2\) ke liye power 1 aur 2 dono ke fractions, aur har ek ke upar linear numerator. Poore denominator \((x^2 + 1)^2(x - 1)\) se multiply kiya; har term ke saath woh factors bache jo us ke apne denominator mein nahi the.

(1) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[1 + 3 + 1 + 1 = A(2)^2\]
\[A = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) par \(x - 1 = 0\), is liye \(A\) ke ilawa sab terms zero. Left side \(6\), right side \(4A\).

Baaqi terms kholein
\[(Bx + C)(x^3 - x^2 + x - 1)\]
\[= Bx^4 + (C - B)x^3 + (B - C)x^2 + (C - B)x - C\]
\[(Dx + E)(x - 1) = Dx^2 + (E - D)x - E\]
Kyun: Pehle \((x - 1)(x^2 + 1) = x^3 - x^2 + x - 1\) banaya, phir \(Bx + C\) se multiply. \(A(x^2 + 1)^2 = A(x^4 + 2x^2 + 1)\) bhi yaad rakhein. Ab har power ka coefficient alag nazar aa raha hai.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^4:\ 1 = A + B,\ B = -\tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[x^3:\ 0 = C - B,\ C = -\tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[x^2:\ 3 = 2A + B - C + D,\ D = 0\]
\[x:\ 1 = C - B + E - D,\ E = 1\]
Kyun: Sab se bari power se neeche ki taraf chale, taa ke har equation mein sirf ek naya constant ho. \(x^2\) wali mein \(2A = 3\) aur \(B - C = 0\), to \(D = 0\). \(x\) wali mein \(C - B = 0\), to \(E = 1\). Constant term se tasdeeq: \(A - C - E = \frac{3}{2} + \frac{1}{2} - 1 = 1\), jo left side ke constant 1 ke barabar hai.

Integrand nayi shakal mein
\[= \dfrac{3}{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot\dfrac{x + 1}{x^2 + 1} + \dfrac{1}{(x^2 + 1)^2}\]
Kyun: \(Bx + C = -\frac{1}{2}x - \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{1}{2}(x + 1)\) aur \(Dx + E = 1\).

Pehle do hisson ka integral
\[\dfrac{3}{2}\ln|x - 1| - \dfrac{1}{4}\ln(x^2 + 1) - \dfrac{1}{2}\tan^{-1} x\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{x + 1}{x^2 + 1}\) ko do mein toda: \(x\) wala hissa \(-\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\ln(x^2 + 1) = -\frac{1}{4}\ln(x^2 + 1)\), aur 1 wala hissa \(-\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1} x\).

Aakhri hissa (\(x = \tan\theta\) rakhein)
\[\int \dfrac{dx}{(x^2 + 1)^2} = \int \cos^2\theta\,d\theta\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left(\theta + \sin\theta\cos\theta\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\tan^{-1} x + \dfrac{x}{2(x^2 + 1)}\]
Kyun: \(dx = \sec^2\theta\,d\theta\) aur \(x^2 + 1 = \sec^2\theta\), is liye integrand \(\frac{\sec^2\theta}{\sec^4\theta} = \cos^2\theta\). \(\cos^2\theta = \frac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}\) ka integral \(\frac{1}{2}(\theta + \sin\theta\cos\theta)\). Wapas \(x\) mein: \(\theta = \tan^{-1} x\) aur \(\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sec^2\theta} = \frac{x}{1 + x^2}\). Yeh bilkul Example 43 wala kaam hai.

Sab hisse jor dein
\[\dfrac{3}{2}\ln|x - 1| - \dfrac{1}{4}\ln(x^2 + 1) + \dfrac{x}{2(x^2 + 1)} + c\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1} x\) aur \(+\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1} x\) aapas mein cancel ho gaye, is liye jawab mein \(\tan^{-1}\) nahi bacha. Yeh kitab ke jawab se bilkul milta hai.
Dhyan dein: Agar aap \(\tan^{-1}\) wale terms cancel hona na dekhein to jawab ghalat nahi hoga, bas lamba lagega; lekin ek bhi sign ghalat ho to cancel nahi hote, is liye signs dobara check karein.

blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 302) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (xiii) hai: \(\frac{3}{2}\ln|x - 1| - \frac{1}{4}\ln(x^2 + 1) + \frac{x}{2(x^2 + 1)} + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
